name: game_state_step
comment: game state 0x03005808: 0 boot (enter_screen) / 1 menus (menu_frame then draw_screen) / 4 race start (race_start_from_table_a; fade 0x10) / 5 race (race_frame_update; then back to the menus)

name: enter_screen
comment: mark_screen_changed; enter handler of screen 0x03005944 (table 0x0812B454; 7/8/15/28/40 extra code); clears profile +0x2F6/+0x2F8; exit screen = -1; draw_screen(1)

name: draw_screen
comment: draw handler of the screen (table 0x0812D370; List/Setup/Intro/Kind38 draw a rand_table number first); full = 1 after a screen change; then message_box_draw

name: menu_back
comment: pops the back stack (top i8 0x0300593C; screens at profile +0x344) into the screen and enter_screen

name: message_box_input
comment: 0x030059F4 = 1 on A (sound 2) / -1 on B when box 0x030059F0 is 2 (sound 3); returns it

name: message_box_draw
comment: (tentative) draws the open message box (0x030059F0 >= 0); arg full

name: list_enter
comment: enter handler of the List screens (0-6 9 27-30 35 36 45 46)

name: list_update
comment: update handler of the List screens

name: list_exit
comment: exit handler of the List screens

name: career_zone_enter
comment: enter handler of the career zone screens 11 12

name: setup_screen_draw
comment: draw handler of the setup screens 10 15 16

name: setup_screen_exit
comment: exit handler of the setup screens 10 15 16

name: intro_update
comment: update handler of the boot/intro screens 21-26 37 47 48 (pages 0x087E5DA8)

name: intro_draw
comment: draw handler of the intro screens

name: intro_exit
comment: exit handler of the intro screens

name: timer_read
comment: (tentative) reads timer n's count (main_frame: timer 3 = the last frame's length)

name: goto_screen
comment: screens <= 0x7F: push the old screen (back stack) and set the new one; List screens clear their cursor slot (profile +0x350); enter_screen. 0x81: exit screen = screen. 0x82: resume the race from pause (15 VBlanks; state 5; palettes; music)

name: list_slot
comment: cursor slot of a List screen (0..16; screen 3 uses 0xF when profile +0x12 is 0); -1 otherwise

name: name_is_valid
comment: the typed name's 9 bytes OR to neither 0 nor 0x20; plays sound 2 either way

name: health_screen_image
comment: (tentative) intro enter on screen 0x2F: (world; 7/8/0xA/9/0xB by language) the language's health and safety image

name: intro_page_setup
comment: (tentative) first call of intro_draw; argument *0x030057F0 (the unpack buffer)

name: menu_blit_material_alt
comment: (tentative) (world; material; x; y) like menu_blit_material; the name screen's letter image (0xDE-0xE1 by language)

name: load_menu_descriptor
comment: (tentative) menu_scene_setup_a: (world; 0x087F2FE8) loads the menu level descriptor into the world

name: text_menu_wrapped_colour
comment: (tentative) (font; key; x; y; width 0xE0/0xEE; lines 0xF; colour): the PSA text and the credits lines

name: text_menu_7
comment: (tentative) (font 0xC; key 0x159; x 0x78; y 0x32; 0xDC; 2; 0): the title's text before loading the save
